stdin.note: The dedicated server is driven from its own console window. It prints "Press Enter to chat" once ready, and CubeCoders' AMP template for this game sets App.AdminMethod=STDIO, i.e. admin input is written to the server process's standard input. There is no RCON, no REST/admin API and no remote console of any kind. The same console command vocabulary is also executed at boot from Risk of Rain 2_Data/Config/server.cfg, where statements are semicolon-terminated (sv_hostname "..."; sv_maxplayers 4;).

notes: Commands: kick_steam <steamid64> and ban_steam <steamid64> both carry the SenderMustBeServer flag, and say carries ExecuteOnServer, per the Risk of Rain 2 wiki command table; wiki.gg and Fandom copies are forks of one wiki and count as ONE source, so independent agreement comes from Gamepur's command list and a Steam discussion where the host workflow is quoted as kick_steam "steam ID". No listPlayers: the base game exposes no roster command. steam_lobby_print_members exists but reads the Steam LOBBY, which a dedicated server does not use for joins, so it is deliberately not recorded as listPlayers; AMP instead scrapes joins/leaves out of the log (NetworkManagerSystem.AddPlayerInternal / 'connection <id> has been disconnected'). No unban command exists in the vanilla command table, and no ban-list file location is published, so unban and banList are omitted rather than guessed. RISK, the reason for confidence low: the vanilla server console prompt reads 'Press Enter to chat', and the community dedicated-server mod R2DSEssentials advertises an 'Interactible Server Console to execute commands directly from the console window' as a feature it ADDS - so it is possible that stdin on an unmodded server only sends chat and does not execute console commands. Nothing published settles this; it needs live verification before these three commands are trusted. Hopoo/Gearbox stopped updating the dedicated server app around 26 May 2022 (per the avivace/ror2-server Docker project), so the command set is unlikely to move. Hosting-panel pages for this game (Nitrado, Psychz, IONOS) document setup only and contain no moderation commands.
